description: This file contains functions related to upgrading an SD card in a legacy system, including checking image compatibility, performing the upgrade process, and copying configuration files.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_check_image
methods.description: Checks whether the image's partition layout matches the target device's layout to determine if a full write is necessary.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the upgrade of the SD card, optionally preserving partition data, writing images to device partitions, and handling bootloader and UUID updates.

methods.name: legacy_sdcard_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration files from backup to the boot partition of the SD card.
